Bonseyes Community Association (BCA) is a non-profit AI-focused association based in Switzerland. BCA was created and inspired by the H2020 Bonseyes AI Marketplace project to ensure that artificial intelligence benefits all of society through open, distributed, and decentralised platforms and technology.

BCA’s mission is to ensure that artificial intelligence (in all forms from narrow to general) which will ultimately create highly autonomous systems benefits all of society – not just a select few. We will attempt to directly build open technology platforms supporting distributed artificial intelligence marketplaces empowering innovators, data scientists, and developers to build and trade value creating, safe, and beneficial AI aligned with societal goals. We will also consider our mission fulfilled if our work aids others to achieve this outcome. To that end, the association pursues the following non- commercial goals:

- Increasing knowledge and understanding of the distributed artificial intelligence systems development across government, universities, industry, and startups.
- Development of an open platform technology and infrastructure for a distributed artificial intelligence marketplace.
- Promoting research into decentralised and distributed artificial intelligence.

entityDescription:
S.A.B. Aerospace Srl is a private and independent SME operating in the Space Business since 2004. The company core business is focused in the development of mechanical systems, sub-systems and mechanisms related to Launchers, Satellites and Payloads.

SAB has been and is currently involved in several projects related to launchers through contracts awarded by ELV, ESA and ARIANESPACE for the development of items such as Adapters, Systems for Payload Multiple launch, Separation Systems and Test apparatus for shock testing. SAB is currently responsible (on behalf of Arianespace) for the Shock testing services executed with the VESTA (VEga Shock Test Apparatus) tool on the payloads to be embarked on the VEGA launcher. Moreover SAB has participated to launch campaigns and is familiar with rules implemented by ESA in the launch space port in French Guyana.

Satellite activities performed by SAB Aerospace are linked to the partnership established in 2010 with OHB System AG and they range from Platform Mechanical Design Development to Mechanical Integration of Satellites including as well MGSE Design and Manufacturing.

SAB Aerospace is performing activities for the development of Optical Payloads and Equipments sub-system in terms of Thermo-mechanical Design, Structures manufacturing, Integration and Environmental Testing.

The above mentioned activities are supported by research program developed in cooperation with a network of research centers for the study of technologies such as Laser Welding Technology, Separation System Technologies, Thermal Control Systems, Advanced Ceramics and Light Alloys.

The company headquarter is in Benevento, an area considered one of the Italian poles concerning aeronautical and aerospace business. In the headquarter S.A.B. Aerospace concentrates all the activities related to Manufacturing, Assembly/Integration and Testing. All the engineering and R/D activities are based in the Ancona office, while a third office is in Milan for Business Development and Marketing. The SAB internal facilities comprises: 
- An Integration facility built inside a 100000 class clean room facility and equipped with a 1ton lifting crane for the handling of the different parts and assembled systems. 
- The Vibration test facility is composed by a 49KN electrodynamics shaker mounted in the clean room described above. 
- A four axes milling machines used to manufacture space components made up of Aluminum, Invar and Peek.

In addition SAB can rely on a manufacturer network for manufacturing of complex mechanical structures.

entityDescription: Geyser Batteries is startup based in Vaasa, Finland, producing (at modules level) a new type of electrochemical energy storage. Our energy storage modules deliver ultra-high power through millions of discharge cycles, they are 100% safe (non-flammable aqueous electrolytes), maintenance free, operate at temperatures down to -60C and have good energy density (similar to lead acid batteries). It is a combination of a supercapacitor and a battery in one electrochemical system without the use of intercalative electrodes. Our novel products are based on the electrochemistry that was discovered by our group over the course of production and R&D of supercapacitors, stemming from 25+ years of experience of our team in that sector.

entityDescription: The IOTA Foundation is a not-for-profit organization established in 2017 and headquartered in Berlin, Germany. The Foundation's mission is to drive the development and standardization of new distributed ledger technologies (DLTs) that enable permissionless innovation ecosystems. The IOTA Foundation works to realize this potential by actively building a collaborative ecosystem of developers, start-ups, private enterprises, and government, civil society and academic institutions with the vision to enable responsible and citizen-centric technology innovation. The IOTA Foundation takes a society-first approach to cutting-edge technological innovation. We employ a collaborative philosophy focused on end-user empowerment and social good rather than towards profit. Concretely, we engage in engineering, research and community organizing efforts around the IOTA Tangle – a new generation of DLT specifically designed to be the open and free trust layer for the Internet-of-Things (IoT). Our aim is to make available to the public a universally utilizable distributed ledger protocol that is stable, scalable, fast and free for all to use. The core functionalities of this DLT protocol include secure data transfer, fee-less micropayments, tamper-proof record-keeping, user-controlled data privacy, distributed computing, and real-time data monitoring and reporting processes. The foundation employees over 100 people across the globe in research, technology development and different adoption verticals. It actively fosters a community of developers, funded over 14 open source projects and engages with academia through the IOTA research council.

entityDescription: agriBORA is an agri-fintech company with a mission to de-risk smallholder agriculture through a balance of technology and human touch. Our products and solutions promote climate change mitigation and adaptation by providing smallholder farmers with access to affordable, reliable, and convenient financial services, climate-smart advisory services, and high-quality inputs. Through our Software as a Service (SaaS) platform, we are connecting farmers with agriHUBS, which are digitally-enabled one-stop-shops where farmers can access high-quality inputs, climate-smart advisory services, and competitive output markets. AgriHUBS also provide access to credit recommendations services that are tailored to the needs of unbanked farmers, enabling them to access financing for climate-smart inputs and technologies such as drought-resistant seeds and irrigation production methods. This helps to build the absorptive capacity of smallholder farming communities, allowing them to adapt to the impacts of climate change and build resilience in the face of climate-related risks.

entityDescription:
The University of Sussex (http://www.sussex.ac.uk) is a leading research-intensive university established in 1961. Over 75% of research activity at Sussex is categorised as world leading or internationally excellent in terms of originality, significance and rigour. 

Sussex has an excellent international reputation and is ranked in the top 50 UK universities (The Guardian University League Tables 2020 and The Complete University Guide 2020), and in the top 150 (146th) in the world (Times Higher Education World University Rankings 2020). In 2020 the QS World Rankings by Subject rated Sussex number one in the world for Development Studies and rated high for research output.
The University has a dynamic and thriving research culture with strengths across the sciences, arts, social sciences and medicine with a focus on interdisciplinary research. It currently has around 17,000 students and 4,000 staff from all over the world including over 1,000 teaching and research staff. It has had three Nobel Prize winners, 14 Fellows of the Royal Society, 12 Fellows of the British Academy and a winner of the prestigious Crafoord Prize on its faculty.
In the financial year 2018/2019 the total income was 323 million and the value of the University’s total portfolio of external project research income was 38 million, ranging from commercial funders to charities and public sector organisations (including governmental departments).
The University of Sussex has experience in dealing with all European Research and Innovation programme matters. It has successfully secured 87 H2020 grants to date: 7 FET, 32 ERC, 21 Societal Challenges, 1 Research Infrastructures, 1 Widening Participation and 25 Marie Skłodowska-Curie projects (5 ITNs, 3 RISE projects, and 17 fellowships). Sussex participates in three FET Flagships: the Human Brain Project, the Humane AI and the Quantum Flagship initiatives.

entityDescription:
My studio specializes in visual communication consultancy for companies and in this we assist the customer at 360 °: logo design, corporate identity, catalogs, brochures, layouts, packaging and web design.
I’ve been working as a Graphic Designer for over 20 years, aiming to face every single project by asking: who is the message to be communicated aimed at and how can I reach the end user in the simplest and most immediate way.
In fact, the phrase that represents me is: " For all companies who want to keep up with the pace of the world, but attract the gaze of those watching". To achieve this in a society full of visual inputs, it is necessary to strike immediately to be recognized with a few well-directed messages.
Creativity is being able to attract attention through the visual message and make people stop, even just for a moment. It’s being remembered!
 
The media we can use nowadays are infinite, but for me "Paper", with its thousand different nuances and appeal to the senses, is still the most effective way: touch, with the use of various embossings, thicknesses or materials; sight, with the various printing technologies; hearing, the sound of the pages turning; and smell, the smell of the ink.
In a world where everyone is racing to go faster it’s important to understand how things are being observed and the importance of providing a clear communication and a strong
visual impact. Here is the winning approach, adopted over the years for the most diverse clients, who have enabled me to maintain an open mind and that creative freshness needed to guarantee solutions that are never obvious or predictable.
Because working every day in different sectors means having one single specialization, that of quality.

entityDescription: Brand Strategy and Consulting:The very existence and growth of every relationship are based on the premise of creation and delivery of value. This is true both for people and companies. We are worth listening to and we provoke interest because we have something to say and we are considered interesting. Thus, the premise is already in place, most of the time implicitly. We must make it explicit. Art Direction and Design:To set our positioning, we must understand the environment in which we are operating. It is a complicated universe, yet often regulated by recurrent habits and instruments. Other subjects establish relationships with our way of being through their own topics and the ways they chose to get attention. Marketing, Media and Events:Relationships occur among subjects, and they demand energy and attention. To isolate a target is not enough; it’s necessary to understand how to start a discussion with it. What we are wearing, the tone of our voices, our timbres and our gestures, all are fundamental to make ourselves heard. In the business world, too, there are some relational metrics to understand and to encode.Strategy and Innovation:To use easy, clear words and concepts in a way that they disappear from the mind of the interlocutor lies at the basis of an effective communication. The interest we provoke is dependant from our uniqueness. Our unique traits have to be so evident to gain attention, become the main leverage points, the reason why we are sought and chosen.
